channel.title: MEYADE GAMES STUDIO blog
channel.description: Stories behind the indie games of MEYADE GAMES STUDIO.

item.title: Unutma: My First Experiment, an Offline Personal Assistant
item.description: How a daily worry ('did I lock the door?') became Unutma: a private notes app, password vault and offline personal assistant that lives on your phone.

item.title: Protokol-Ø: What I Learned Making My First Game
item.description: Protokol-Ø is an AI thriller told through cases: approve, reject or escalate, and your decisions matter. What my first game taught me about making games.

item.title: NEO: An Interactive Horror Story With 20 Endings
item.description: NEO started as a small interactive story experiment and grew to 285 scenes, 675 branches and 20 endings, all free. The clock stopped at 17:34.

item.title: Mobies: A Customer Book for Small Businesses
item.description: Mobies grew out of Unutma into an app for barbers, salons, tailors and repair shops: who came, who's late, who's due, plus quotes, invoices and reminders.

item.title: Bolt & Breath: Why I Wanted to Ride a Dragon
item.description: I wanted to ride a dragon, so I built one in Unity. The story of Bolt & Breath: Last Dragon, the sea that fought back, and the updates still coming.

item.title: Foot Tennis Stars: From Stick Figures to Online Matches
item.description: Foot Tennis Stars started as a 2D offline game. Then came a league, a cup, 3D characters and, hardest of all, online matches. Here's how it grew.

item.title: Prof. Nano: A Science Game for Turkish Kids
item.description: Prof. Nano is a science game for children, built first in Turkish and now in App Store review. Why I made it, and what I plan to add for parents and kids.

item.title: Tomb Maze: The Labyrinth Game I Always Wanted to Make
item.description: Tomb Maze: Horror Escape is a horror maze game: find your way out of the tomb before what's inside finds you. It hears you. In review, coming very soon.
